scope.statement: The existing integer order on fraction-field units respects integer powers and inversion and is exactly the negative logarithm of the actual maximal-ideal valuation. Changing the irreducible uniformizer does not change that order.
scope.conditions: One DVR and its specified fraction field, in independent universes. All integer orders, including poles, are retained. No new order, valuation, uniformizer-unit or additive-homomorphism model is introduced.

scope.statement: The ordinary field norm multiplies the native DVR order by the actual residue-field degree for every fraction-field unit, including negative orders. The nonzero-element version supplies the native nonzero norm proof, and the literal negative-logarithm formula needs no chosen uniformizer.
scope.conditions: Finite torsion-free extension of DVRs with specified compatible fraction fields, both scalar towers and explicit finite-dimensionality of the field extension. Locality and integral closure are derived. No perfectness, separability, henselianity, prime-degree or invertible ramification-exponent assumption. The old relative ideal-norm helper and Milnor transfer are not claimed.
